findings.text: Times are compared through UnixNano(), which is undefined for instants outside roughly years 1678–2262. For example, Greater(time.Now(), time.Time{}) (year 1) overflows int64, so the comparison can give the wrong result. A direct timeObj1.Compare(timeObj2), or Before/After/Equal, would avoid this.
